{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module JobWorker where

import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as C8
import Data.Word (Word8, Word32)
import Data.Bits (xor, shiftL, shiftR, (.&.), (.|.))
import Data.IORef
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Control.Concurrent (forkIO, threadDelay, MVar, newMVar, takeMVar, putMVar)
import Control.Monad (forever, when, unless)
import System.IO.Unsafe (unsafePerformIO)
import Crypto.Cipher.AES (AES256)
import Crypto.Cipher.Types (BlockCipher(..), Cipher(..), IV, makeIV, nullIV, ivAdd)
import Crypto.Error (throwCryptoError)
import Crypto.Random (getRandomBytes)
import Data.ByteArray (convert)

-- Encrypted job storage with role-based execution
data JobPriority = Low | Normal | High | Critical deriving (Eq, Ord, Show)
data Role = Worker | Supervisor | Admin deriving (Eq, Ord, Show)

data Job = Job
  { jobId       :: Word32
  , jobPayload  :: BS.ByteString
  , jobPriority :: JobPriority
  , jobRole     :: Role
  , jobNonce    :: BS.ByteString  -- random 16-byte IV/nonce
  } deriving (Show)

data WorkerState = WorkerState
  { wsRole      :: Role
  , wsJobQueue  :: [Job]
  , wsProcessed :: [Word32]
  , wsKey       :: BS.ByteString  -- 32-byte AES-256 key
  }

-- Build an AES-256 cipher context from a key.
-- Requires the key to be exactly 32 bytes.
mkCipher :: BS.ByteString -> AES256
mkCipher key = throwCryptoError (cipherInit key)

-- Build an IV from a raw 16-byte nonce.
mkIV :: BS.ByteString -> IV AES256
mkIV nonce =
  case makeIV nonce of
    Just iv -> iv
    Nothing -> nullIV

-- Encrypt job payload using AES-256 in CTR mode with a per-job random nonce.
encryptPayload :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString
encryptPayload key nonce plaintext =
  let cipher = mkCipher key
      iv     = mkIV nonce
  in ctrCombine cipher iv plaintext

-- CTR mode is symmetric: the same operation decrypts.
decryptPayload :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString
decryptPayload = encryptPayload

-- Generate a cryptographically secure random nonce (16 bytes for AES block size).
generateNonce :: IO BS.ByteString
generateNonce = getRandomBytes 16

-- Role elevation check: determines if a job can be executed by current worker
-- The privilege boundary is enforced by comparing role ordinals
roleOrdinal :: Role -> Word32
roleOrdinal Worker     = 0
roleOrdinal Supervisor = 1
roleOrdinal Admin      = 2

-- Check if worker is authorized to execute a job
-- Worker can execute jobs at their level or below
canExecute :: WorkerState -> Job -> Bool
canExecute ws job =
  let workerLevel = roleOrdinal (wsRole ws)
      jobLevel    = roleOrdinal (jobRole job)
  in workerLevel >= jobLevel

-- Process a single job
processJob :: WorkerState -> Job -> IO (Either String BS.ByteString)
processJob ws job = do
  if canExecute ws job
    then do
      let decrypted = decryptPayload (wsKey ws) (jobNonce job) (jobPayload job)
      putStrLn $ "Executing job " ++ show (jobId job) ++ " at role " ++ show (jobRole job)
      return $ Right decrypted
    else
      return $ Left $ "Insufficient privileges for job " ++ show (jobId job)

-- Submit a job to the worker queue
submitJob :: MVar WorkerState -> Job -> IO ()
submitJob stateVar job = do
  ws <- takeMVar stateVar
  putMVar stateVar ws { wsJobQueue = wsJobQueue ws ++ [job] }

-- Worker loop: processes jobs from queue
runWorker :: MVar WorkerState -> IO ()
runWorker stateVar = forever $ do
  ws <- takeMVar stateVar
  case wsJobQueue ws of
    [] -> do
      putMVar stateVar ws
      threadDelay 100000
    (job:rest) -> do
      result <- processJob ws job
      case result of
        Right _ -> putMVar stateVar ws { wsJobQueue = rest, wsProcessed = jobId job : wsProcessed ws }
        Left err -> do
          putStrLn err
          putMVar stateVar ws { wsJobQueue = rest }

-- Initialize a worker with a given role and encryption key
initWorker :: Role -> BS.ByteString -> IO (MVar WorkerState)
initWorker role key = do
  let ws = WorkerState role [] [] key
  newMVar ws

-- Example: create a properly authorized job with a securely random nonce
createAuthorizedJob :: Word32 -> BS.ByteString -> Role -> JobPriority -> BS.ByteString -> IO Job
createAuthorizedJob jid key role prio payload = do
  nonce <- generateNonce  -- cryptographically secure random nonce, never reused
  let encrypted = encryptPayload key nonce payload
  return $ Job jid encrypted prio role nonce
